name: edgar-entity-mcp
description: SEC EDGAR filings, XBRL financials, Form 4 insider trades and state business-entity registries for AI agents.
long_description: Research any US company from official public data: resolve tickers to CIKs, read 10-K/10-Q sections as clean text, get normalized financials from XBRL, compare companies with SEC frames, parse Form 4 insider trades, and look up legal entities in NY, CO, OR, CT and PA Secretary of State registries. Compact JSON with source URLs. A hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint is also available at https://edgar-entity-mcp.vercel.app/mcp.

sec_user_agent.title: SEC User-Agent
sec_user_agent.description: Required by SEC fair-access policy: your name or company and an email, e.g. 'Acme Research jane@acme.com'.

socrata_app_token.title: Socrata app token (optional)
socrata_app_token.description: Raises rate limits for state registry lookups. Free from any Socrata portal (e.g. data.ny.gov developer settings).

tools.name: search_company
tools.description: Find SEC-registered public companies by ticker or name (fuzzy)

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Company profile from SEC EDGAR submissions: legal name, tickers, exchanges, SIC code + industry, state of incorporation, fiscal year end, EIN, filer category, business/mailing addresses, former names,

tools.name: list_filings
tools.description: List a company's EDGAR filings newest-first, filtered by form type and filing-date range

tools.name: get_filing_document
tools.description: Fetch an SEC filing's primary document (HTML converted to clean text, tables preserved as aligned rows)

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Key financial metrics normalized from SEC XBRL companyfacts, one row per fiscal period (deduped; as-filed values from the filing that reported the period)

tools.name: get_xbrl_concept
tools.description: All reported values of one XBRL concept for one company (SEC companyconcept API), newest first, deduped by period

tools.name: compare_companies

tools.name: lookup_business_entity
tools.description: Search Secretary of State business-entity registries (official open data) by entity name and/or state entity id
